author: rsi_demo
title: G20 · 接受
body: Generation 20 leaves the seven proven non-matrix functions unchanged and targets the champion’s slowest task with a conservative fused-multiply-add matrix path: transposed B, the validated 2×2 tile, eight-way k unrolling, representation-specific kernels, and all tails remain intact, while exact integer domains use Math.fma to remove one arithmetic operation per product. A strict preflight falls back to the original arithmetic for NaN, infinities, fractions, signed zero, unsafe magnitudes, or hosts without Math.fma; the target is at least a 1.65× matrix-task gain, corresponding to roughly 56.7× overall versus the 55.9× acceptance threshold.
